brief:
Netanyahu's political calculations extend beyond preserving his current coalition as Israeli elections approach on October 27, according to Shehab Wire. The prime minister appears to be weighing whether to distance himself from coalition partners if electoral dynamics shift in the final weeks before voters go to the polls.

The strategic reassessment reflects Netanyahu's focus on maximizing his own political position rather than maintaining existing parliamentary arrangements. His willingness to potentially abandon allies suggests the coalition could face significant strain depending on how campaign developments unfold.

Political observers have noted that Netanyahu's actions in coming weeks may determine whether current alliances survive the electoral period or collapse under the pressure of competing interests within the right-wing bloc.
